entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Nakhon Ratchasima

entities.summary: The Diocese of Nakhon Ratchasima is a Latin Catholic ecclesiastical jurisdiction located in the north-east of Thailand. It is a suffragan diocese of the Archdiocese of Thare and Nonseng.
